architecture: shared encoder + two linear heads (10-way request type, binary escalation), pooled from the [CLS] token
checkpoint_selection: best validation loss, not final epoch; best epoch varied 18-29 across runs

data_split.grouping: grouped by customer so no customer appears in more than one split
data_split.note: test split touched exactly once, at the end

learning_rate_comparison_note: Results were inconsistent across full reruns of this comparison (see results/learning_rate_comparison.csv and report Step 14/24): 2e-5 was kept as the standard starting point for fine-tuning pretrained transformers, not because one run proved it decisively best.

base_model_candidates_excluded.microsoft/mdeberta-v3-base: Unrecoverable CUDA out-of-memory error even at batch_size=8, from its disentangled attention mechanism -- an architectural limitation, not a performance result.

training_cost.note: T4 on-demand pricing on major clouds runs USD 0.42-0.53/hr; at that rate one 30-epoch run costs under USD 0.04.

stability_check.description: Same model/settings retrained 5 times from scratch to measure run-to-run variance from random initialization and batch order, since the training set is only 130 examples.
